shots.name: trust
shots.prompt: Vertical phone-format photo, subject centred in the middle of the frame with space above and below. A confident, well-dressed Nigerian woman in her fifties, an estate treasurer, sits at a tidy desk in the estate's management office going over figures on a laptop, calm and assured, reading glasses on. Window behind onto palms and the estate gate. Bright daylight. Laptop screen facing away from camera.
